channel.desc: Diandra has a kind, gentle and loving nature. He and his sister Elsa live happily with their father, Harun. However, all that changed when Lena and her daughter, Clara, entered Diandra and Elsa's life because Harun married Lena. They both dislike Diandra and Elsa, and always do bad things to Diandra and Elsa.
